headline: Emergency update follows faults in the September Windows 11 patch
summary: Four reports on one running story: the September Windows 11 patch broke audio on some USB devices, and Microsoft shipped an out-of-band update. The outlets do not agree that it worked — one says the update resolves the audio fault, another that some USB audio is still silent. One also reports crashes on AMD, HP and Lenovo systems.
